notes: E-Learning: a redesigned home that matches the website, with a welcome card, quick links, a rotating banner with search, swipeable course updates, and course cards you can filter by category and subcategory.
E-Learning: Tutors now show each instructor's rating, with Show all for longer lists.

E-Learning: lesson text keeps its formatting (headings, lists, links), CXC past papers open with Study and the CXC hub has a subject search, and instructors get a Create Course button in the course catalog.
Market: share any listing straight from the catalog, and sellers can set one price and stock for every variant at once.
Market: new Pets & Adoption section. Browse pets to adopt or buy, search and filter them, save favourites and see each pet's details.
Pets & Adoption: send a carer an enquiry, list a pet for review, and read the pet safety guide and local shelter details.
Market: sellers can add up to 3 videos (MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 50 MB each) to a listing's gallery alongside photos, and buyers can play them on the listing.
Links: ourlime.com links to Market orders and checkout, E-Hub searches, provider services and the E-Hub terms sections now open the right place in the app.
Updates: the download bar now moves while a quick update downloads, so you can see it working.
Updates: a download that stalls stops after 3 minutes and lets you try again, instead of waiting forever.
Loading screens across the app now show the real page's layout (headers, sections and cards) while content loads.
What's new: the list now scrolls, with a close button and a link to all release notes always in view.
Updates: the download sheet now reads "Downloading the update" and says Ourlime restarts when it's ready.
E-Learning: a course home for enrolled students with Next up, a to-do list of quizzes and assignments, recent activity and resources, plus Modules, Quizzes and Assignments pages.
E-Learning: lessons open exactly where you tapped, Continue picks up at your next lesson, and Mark as Done moves you on.
E-Learning: filter courses by level and free or paid, sort by newest or top rated, and see which courses you're enrolled in.
E-Learning for instructors: create quizzes and assignments, save grades as drafts, and apply with the full instructor application.
E-Learning fixes: lessons added as documents now show up, and quizzes with short-answer questions are scored correctly.
E-Hub: save products, compare two side by side and keep a preparation cart, plus a new home with Shop, Hire, Discover and Grow.
E-Hub: ask a provider about a specific service, share provider profiles, read the E-Hub terms in the app, and delete an enquiry before it's read.
Market: product pages with colour and size options, reviews, related items, shipping details and Report listing.
Market: checkout with shipping or pickup, including each seller's pickup contacts, plus My orders to track, confirm and review.
Market for sellers: My listings to add, edit, unpublish and duplicate products, and seller orders to mark items shipped or ready for pickup.
Market: more filters (seller type, colour, size, in stock, newest), saved searches, save for later and a grid or list view.
Updates are now required: when a new version or quick update is ready, Ourlime shows it and you tap Update now to continue. The update screen can't be closed until it's installed.
You now get a notification when a quick update is ready, not only for new versions on Google Play.
Typing: the keyboard no longer covers what you're typing. Lime captions, comments, reports, settings, job and event forms, chats with support and every other text box now stay above the keyboard.
Lime cover: Edit cover now opens on the frame you picked on Confirm video, instead of jumping back to the start.
What's new now has a "See all release notes" link to Settings → Release notes, where you can read what changed in every version.
Lime video cover: the cover you pick in Edit cover is now saved exactly, instead of a nearby frame that could be a second or more away.
Quick updates now wait for you: when one is ready, Ourlime asks first, and nothing is downloaded or installed until you tap "Update now". Tap Later and the app stays as it is.
Release notes: Settings → Release notes lists what changed in every version and quick update.
Lime video cover: the Finish button in Edit cover works on the first tap, and the frame strip loads even after you've already picked a cover.
E-Hub forms: the keyboard no longer covers what you type in Seller Center, your business account, enquiries and the enquiry form on a provider's page.
Business account: a category you typed is now saved when you tap Save, even if you didn't tap Add first.
Sharing an E-Hub product now sends just the link, so chats show the product's name, price and photo.
Fixes: long descriptions scroll inside their box so you can see what you're typing, image upload problems show a clear message, and the draft delete button reads "Delete draft".
Updates from Google Play: when a new version of Ourlime is out, the app tells you right away and installs it through Play's own update screen, without sending you to the store.
Fixes: the "What's new" list now scrolls, so you can read every note and reach the "Got it" button.
E-Hub is in the app: browse the catalog, open product pages, discover sellers and service providers, view their profiles and send enquiries.
E-Hub Seller Center: set up your storefront, add and edit products, and see how your shop is doing.
Business account: create and manage your business profile from the app.
Course lessons: watch lesson videos, take quizzes and open lesson files (PDF, Word) without leaving the app.
Assignments: hand in a written answer and files, then see your grade and your instructor's feedback.
New progress & grades page for each course: completion, average quiz score and your result for every lesson.
Course reviews: read what other students say and leave your own rating.
Teach on Ourlime: apply to become an instructor, create and publish courses, and grade your students' work.
Events: a new event page with comments, plus a Calendar view that shows what's on each day.
Games: a new Games hub with Trini Wordle and Trini GeoGuesser. Find places across T&T on the map and climb the leaderboard.
Fixes: E-Learning and E-Hub screens that wouldn't load, Seller Center closing on open, broken card layouts, and member names that showed an email address.
